steps.npc: My name is David Andrews. I'm the Head Councillor of the Kourend Council.

options.text: Tell me about the Kourend Council.

steps.player: Tell me about the Kourend Council.

steps.npc: Kourend's last King, Kharedst IV, had only one child when he died. She was too young to take the throne, so the Kourend Council was formed to look after things until she came of age.
Alas, she was very close to her father and his sudden death drove her to insanity. With no suitable ruler, the Kourend Council was made permanent.
The Kourend Council is made up of four councillors. Every four years there is an election for the people to decide who the councillors should be.
One of the councillors holds the position of Head Councillor and this rotates every year. I am the current Head Councillor.

steps.text: If the player has not completed The Queen of Thieves:

steps.npc: The other councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson.

steps.text: If the player has completed The Queen of Thieves:

steps.npc: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the Council is currently vacent after the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.

steps.player: So where do the five houses fit in?

steps.npc: The five houses of Kourend each have their own leader who rules over their city. The leaders of the individual houses must enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council, but can otherwise rule as they see fit.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.player: Well I do enjoy it when people get what they deserve.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.npc: You'll never know what it's like to be on top of the world. The power I had was unconquerable. I'd do it all again without hesitation.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.player: You never had any power. You were just a puppet. You've always been nothing, and that's all you'll ever be.
Enjoy your cell, puppet. Won't be seeing you.
